name: Albania

facts.religion: Muslim about 50% (Sunni and Bektashi), Catholic and Orthodox Christian, many non-practising

snapshot: Edi Rama won a fourth term in 2025 and is racing to join the EU by 2030, in a country that emptied out through emigration after communism.
culture: Under Enver Hoxha, Albania became the world's first officially atheist state and the most isolated country in Europe, leaving hundreds of thousands of concrete bunkers. Today Muslims, Catholics and Orthodox Christians live side by side with little friction. Iso-polyphony, a form of folk singing, is UNESCO-listed, and the besa, a code of honour, is part of national identity.
society: Around a third of Albanians live abroad, mainly in Italy, Greece and Britain. Tourism along the Riviera has boomed, as have property and cannabis-linked money laundering. Rama has appointed an AI-generated "minister" to oversee public procurement as an anti-corruption gimmick. Organised crime groups have reach across Europe.
baseline: Edi Rama's Socialist Party won a fourth consecutive term in May 2025 with a large majority. Albania has opened all negotiating clusters with the EU and aims to finish talks by 2027. The opposition Democratic Party, led by former prime minister Sali Berisha, who faces corruption charges, disputes the results.
